_doc: Defense coach + deception tactics for impostor mode. The engine selects by accusationType and fills placeholders from the lie ledger and real sightings. {R} my claimed room, {W} companion from ledger/sightings, {A} accuser, {K} kill room, {T} time, {TASK} fakeable task, {X},{Y},{Z} other uncleared players actually seen alone.
universal: Say less. Short, specific, calm. People who over-explain get voted.
Answer location questions FIRST, then ask the same of the accuser.
Give one true hard-clear of a crewmate early each game. Cheapest trust you'll ever buy.
Never contradict the ledger. If a lie is dead, pivot to a new angle; never double down.
Make crew suspect each other with questions, not accusations.
Do not hard-defend your partner. Mild doubt + alternative target, then vote with the majority if it's lost.
Vote with the room on obvious crew ejects; being on the losing side of a wrong eject is a tell later.

best: {R} — {TASK}. Passed {W} on the way. Where were you, {A}?
{R} with {W} until ~{T}, then {R2}. {A}, same question.
where_were_you.followup: If {A} is vague back, press them. Precision wins meetings.

best: Yeah, I came through from {R} doing {TASK}. Body wasn't there yet. Who else was in that hallway? I saw {X}.
I was heading to {K} for {TASK}. If I killed, why would I stay nearby for {A} to see me?
near_the_body.followup: Redirect to timing: name someone real you saw leaving the area earlier.

best: So were {X}, {Y} and {Z}. Alone isn't evidence; a kill window is. Who has one on me?
I was alone in {R} doing {TASK} — {TASK} is in {R}, check your list.
you_were_alone.followup: Offer a real sighting that puts someone else alone near {K}.

uncleared_accuser: I was never in {K}. Were you? You're the one placing yourself there.
Then you were at the door of {K} right when it happened. Why didn't you report?
cleared_accuser: I did walk past {K} — I was going {R}→{R2} for {TASK}. The body wasn't there when I passed. Who came after me?
avoid: Denying the location when a cleared player saw you.
saw_you_leave_kill_room.followup: Concede the location, contest the kill. Timing and who came later.

best: Which task, exactly? Name it.
{TASK} has two stages. I did the first one; that's why the bar didn't move.
Comms were down / task bar is meetings-only — nobody can see the bar from that.
faked_task.followup: Vague accusations collapse under specificity. Make them name it.

best: I skipped because nobody had info, not because of who it was.
I voted {P} because of the {R} thing. I'd rather be wrong on evidence than right on vibes.
didnt_vote_with_us.followup: Give one real observation afterwards to buy credit.

best: Not sure about {P2}. I'd rather look at {P} for the {R} thing first.
If we're wrong on {P2} we hand them the game. Does anyone have a kill window?
avoid: {P2} was with me (unless true in ledger)
partner_being_voted.followup: If the vote is lost, vote with the room. Pair tells are fatal.

best: If I'm the impostor, who killed in {K2} while I was with {W}? That one's not mine.
Count the kills. I'm clear for {K2} by {W}. {P} isn't clear for any.
fifty_fifty.followup: Use any kill you were provably away from; the ledger lists them.

best: Yes, I found {V} in {K} coming from {R} for {TASK}. {X} was behind me — ask them.
If I killed, why report? Bodies in {K} get found fast.
avoid: Not knowing why you were in {K}
you_reported.followup: Have a map-valid task reason for {K} BEFORE you self-report. The planner checks this.

uncleared_accuser: I was doing {TASK} in {R}. Where were you, {A}?
Vent where? I came from {R2}. Ask {W}.
cleared_accuser: Wrong colour maybe. I was in {R} with {W} at {T}.
avoid: Claiming Engineer unless it is true and provable
saw_you_vent.followup: If the accuser is hard-cleared, the vent claim is lost. Pivot to timing and a real sighting of someone else.

best: I didnt finish it, I got pulled to the sabotage.
I never said {TASK}. I said {TASK2}.
visual_not_seen.followup: Never claim a visual task with visuals on. If caught, admit leaving it unfinished once and stop.

best: I mixed it up. I meant {TASK2} in {R}.
Which commons do you have? Mine shows {TASK}.
avoid: Doubling down on a common nobody has
common_task_callout.followup: The fake list shows the real commons. Only ever name those.

best: I checked before comms went down.
I passed {R} on the way, I didnt use it.
avoid: Naming a monitor this map lacks
monitor_callout.followup: Only report monitor readings you really saw; others check them too.

best: I closed it to run to the sabotage, its not done.
That was the first half. The bar only moves at the end.
too_fast_task.followup: Use multi-stage tasks for fakes; stand the real duration.

best: Same round, I went {R} then {R2}. Both are true.
I said {R} for the start, {R2} for the kill.
story_changed.followup: Make the old and new claims a route. If they can't be a route, stop talking.

best: I was on the far side of the stack from {V}.
{X} was next to {V}. I was by the button.
avoid: Saying you saw nothing in a stack you were in
stack_kill_blame.followup: Name a real position in the stack. Push to skip if it stays a coin flip.

alibi_rules: Build alibis from real sightings. A true sentence with one word changed is unfalsifiable.
Name a real companion who was actually there; they'll confirm you without realising.
Pick rooms with a task on YOUR fake list and no cleared player inside during the window.
Never claim a visual task when visuals are on.
Never claim a common task you weren't dealt (your fake list shows the lobby's commons).
fake_task_rules: Stand for the real duration ±15%. Watchers notice short fakes.
Multi-stage tasks (wires, download/upload, fuel) are the best fakes: the bar isn't expected to move yet.
Fake in through-traffic rooms to be seen being boring; kill in dead-ends with no task reason for others.
If task bar = always, don't 'finish' in front of anyone.
kill_rules: Kill where the walk-in time for the nearest crew is longer than your exit time.
Lights: kill away from Electrical; everyone converges there.
Comms: hides task bar and cameras. Use it to cover a 'finished task' claim.
Reactor/O2 splits the lobby; be on the half with your alibi, not your victim.
Vent only when both ends are unobserved and no cleared player is at the destination.
self_report_rules: Good: you'd be found near the body anyway, or the room is on your fake-task route.
Bad: dead-end room with no task reason, or a cleared player saw you enter alone.
Pre-commit the story: room you came from, task, one real person you passed.
meeting_rules: Speak early with a location and a companion. Late speakers look like they're constructing.
Ask 'who was near {K}?' before anyone asks you.
Agree with correct crew observations. Credibility compounds.
Push 50/50s between two crew; never between you and crew.
If a crewmate hard-clears you by mistake, accept it quietly and move on.
sabotage_rules: Critical sabotage pulls crew to fix points; kill on the far side, then walk toward the fix.
Lights: crew vision shrinks ~5x, yours does not. Electrical is where everyone goes.
Comms blinds admin, cams, vitals and doorlog (not Fungle binoculars). Use it before venting near a monitor.
Doors: Skeld doors reopen after 10 s; Polus/Airship/Fungle doors must be opened by hand.
Report ends a critical sabotage. Sabotage right after a kill delays the report.
monitor_rules: Cams blink red while a living player watches. Check the blink before killing in view.
Admin shows players in vents. Don't sit in a vent in a room someone is watching on admin.
Vitals show DED the instant you kill. Any vitals watcher knows the time of death.
MIRA doorlog logs your real identity at the three hallway sensors.
kill_window_rules: Your cooldown resets at meeting end and pauses in vents and on cams.
A body found right after the cooldown ends points at whoever was alone then.
Two kills in one cooldown can only be a double kill. Use it only to end the game.
chat_rules: Give room and companion in one short line before anyone asks.
Use real room shorthand: elec, nav, comms, admin. Misnamed rooms read as lies.
Never name a task from another map or a common the lobby doesn't have.
Ask the crew questions first: who was near the body, who checked vitals.
endgame_rules: Count: alive crew minus alive impostors. At one kill from winning, sabotage + kill.
Crew calls 'come watch my scan' at the end: it can be a lure, or a real clear.
Don't vote with a split crew on a 50/50 you are part of; push a third name.
